2607.29235.title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
2607.29235.paper_summary: Although world-action models (WAMs) enhance long-horizon robot control by predicting visual evolution before acting, long-horizon reliability demands repeated re-grounding in real observations--not recursive rollout. Existing WAMs address this by refreshing history or KV cache with ground-truth data between chunks. However, such chunk-wise feedback operates at a coarse temporal granularity and thus fails to correct prediction errors at the individual time-step level. To address this, we propose Feedback Flow Matching (FBFM), a training-free inference mechanism that pushes re-grounding inside the actively generated chunk. During flow matching, FBFM applies a masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field: it leverages the preceding action chunk to guide generation of the next action chunk, and uses the image observed after executing that preceding chunk to guide the next frame prediction. This cross-chunk pairing--where feedback from one chunk arrives in time to shape the next--creates an asynchronous loop that corrects errors without waiting for chunk boundaries. Being training-free, the mechanism improves responsiveness to unexpected events and suppresses drift in long-horizon tasks. We evaluate FBFM on both a joint-generation WAM (DreamZero) and a stage-wise WAM (LingBot-VA). On selected LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 tasks, it improves success rates by over 5% in favorable settings, and real-world robot observation-prediction diagnostics show notably better tracking. We argue that FBFM offers a new paradigm for fine-grained online correction, bridging open-loop flow generation with closed-loop real-world dynamics.
2607.29235.paper_summary_zh: 雖然世界行動模型（WAMs）透過在行動前預測視覺演變來增強長期機器人控制，但長期可靠性要求在真實觀察中重複重新基準，而不是遞歸展開。現有的 WAMs 通過在塊之間用真實數據刷新歷史或 KV 緩存來解決這一問題。然而，這種按塊反饋以粗略的時間粒度運作，因此無法在單個時間步驟層面上修正預測錯誤。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了反饋流匹配（FBFM），這是一種無需訓練的推理機制，將重新基準推進到主動生成的塊內。在流匹配過程中，FBFM 對條件速度場應用遮罩偽逆修正：它利用前一個行動塊來指導下一個行動塊的生成，並使用在執行該前一塊後觀察到的圖像來指導下一幀的預測。這種跨塊配對——一個塊的反饋及時到達以塑造下一個塊——創造了一個異步循環，能在不等待塊邊界的情況下修正錯誤。由於無需訓練，該機制提高了對意外事件的反應能力，並抑制了長期任務中的漂移。我們在一個聯合生成的 WAM（DreamZero）和一個階段式 WAM（LingBot-VA）上評估了 FBFM。在選定的 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin2.0 任務中，它在有利的設置下成功率提高了超過 5%，而現實世界的機器人觀察-預測診斷顯示出顯著更好的跟踪。我們認為 FBFM 提供了一種新的細粒度在線修正範式，將開環流生成與閉環真實世界動態橋接起來。
